scheme_name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls (UG Technical Degrees - BTech/BE/BPharm)
authority: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education, Govt of India
jurisdiction: Central Government / AICTE Scheme (Disbursed via National Scholarship Portal)
benefit: ₹50,000 per annum lump-sum scholarship for every year of UG technical degree study (up to 4 years)

criteria.label: Female candidate qualification (Girls empowerment initiative)
criteria.plain_description: Scheme is exclusively for girl students admitted to technical degree courses.
criteria.source_clause: AICTE Pragati Scheme Guidelines Clause 2.1 - Target Group
criteria.remediation: Verify that applicant is a female student.

criteria.label: Admitted to 1st year of AICTE approved UG Technical Degree program
criteria.plain_description: Student must be enrolled in an AICTE-approved degree level technical course (B.E., B.Tech, B.Pharm, Arch).
criteria.source_clause: AICTE Pragati Guidelines Clause 2.2 - Course Eligibility
criteria.remediation: Upload AICTE institute admission receipt or bonafide certificate.

criteria.label: Annual family income threshold ceiling (<= ₹8,00,000 per annum)
criteria.plain_description: Total family income from all sources must not exceed ₹8 Lakh per year.
criteria.source_clause: AICTE Pragati Guidelines Clause 2.3 - Income Criterion
criteria.remediation: Upload valid Income Certificate showing household annual income under ₹8 Lakh.

criteria.label: Aadhaar identity and DBT bank linkage
criteria.plain_description: Student must have an active savings account seeded with Aadhaar.
criteria.remediation: Upload Aadhaar card linked with student's bank account.

application.office_name: AICTE Approval Cell / College Student Welfare Nodal Officer
documents_to_carry: Admission letter issued by Centralized Counseling / College for B.Tech/B.E./B.Pharm
Valid Income Certificate issued by Tahsildar/SDM (income <= ₹8 Lakh)
Student Aadhaar Card and Seeded Bank Passbook
process_steps: Register on National Scholarship Portal (NSP) via One-Time Registration (OTR)
Select Scheme: AICTE - PRAGATI SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME FOR GIRL STUDENTS (DEGREE)
Enter tuition fees and upload AICTE college admission letter and income proof
College Head of Institution (HOI) validates admission through NSP portal
AICTE sanctions ₹50,000/yr disbursed directly into student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account
